summary: @servicetitan/anvil2 3.9.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) release from github.com/oven-sh/bun, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against math_init.js at the tarball root. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line obfuscated script using an integer-encoded string-array with a shuffle/rotate decoder (the `WV8StW` function over the `n7gIxM` array) — the obfuscator.io fingerprint — and its name has no relation to the documented purpose of a React UI component library. The alternate Bun runtime is used to execute the payload so Node-focused tooling and lifecycle inspection do not see what runs. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js sit at the tarball root and are not listed in package.json `files` (declared as `["dist", "token", "CHANGELOG.md"]`), meaning they were shipped outside the maintainer's declared manifest — consistent with a compromised publish of an otherwise legitimate ServiceTitan React library. The payload executes with the installer's privileges on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
